intended_object: The induced map on connected components of a simple graph: a function f : V → β that takes the same value at both ends of every path in G descends to a map G.ConnectedComponent → β (the universal property of the quotient by reachability). Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: G.ConnectedComponent is the quotient of V by G.Reachable, and the body is exactly Quot.lift f. Its hypothesis asks that f agree at the two ends of every path. This is equivalent to asking that f agree on reachable vertices, because two vertices are reachable from each other exactly when a path joins them (every walk can be shortened to a path). The proof obligation is discharged correctly via Reachable.elim_path. The definition is stated for any simple graph and any target Sort*, which is the natural generality. It is the intended specialisation of the general quotient lift, not a narrower re-implementation of it.
